answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must lock stake across an asymmetric validation ridge, burning verifiable tokens for every identity provisioned. Like extracting dense ferrous ore from deep basalt strata, identity generation enforces a quadratic penalty: creating n identities burns C(n) = k * n^2 stake, imposing superlinear cost scaling that renders distributed multi-agent spoofing economically unviable against the consensus pool.
